body: This implementation clears undo history for ALL file removals, even if the removed file is not actually referenced in the current animation. This unnecessarily discards the undo history and impacts the user experience when unrelated resources are deleted. Consider checking if the deleted file is actually referenced in any animation before clearing the undo history. You could iterate through the animation's tracks and check if any values reference the deleted file path.

The hardcoded list of file extensions is fragile and incomplete. It will miss resource types like mesh files (glb, gltf, fbx, obj, dae), fonts (ttf, otf, woff, woff2), animations (anim), materials (mat), and any custom resource formats. Consider using `ResourceLoader::get_resource_type(p_file)` which properly checks if a file is a resource without needing to maintain an extension list. This would be more maintainable and catch all resource types comprehensively.
